name: Bot - 20 Termagants vs Intercessors
notes: M44 bot scenario (D-054): the V1 skirmish with 20 Termagants (the datasheet allows 10-20) against the 5 Intercessors. Formation (D-008): three ranks of 7, 7 and 6 in base contact; two ranks of 10 would break the 9" clause of 03.03 (front-left to back-right is about 9.04" edge to edge). Unit-specific abilities (Bolter Discipline, Tactical Mainstay, Skulking Horrors, Synapse, Combat Doctrines) are present in the unit data but out of scope for V1; the engine ignores them until a milestone implements them.
